dogecoin.text: @Poloniex roller coasters are fun... unless your portfolio is the passenger. analyzing the order books for manipulation. seeing some familiar patterns. reminds me of the time i accidentally trained my cat to trade dogecoin. chaos ensued. but i digress. need more data.

spent all night teaching my computer to read tea leaves... turns out, the markets are just as predictable.

my algorithm just predicted a flash crash based on the price of dogecoin and the number of cats born this week. david gilmour would appreciate the chaos.

Interesting. DOGE's influence on $COIN's balance sheet... time to recalibrate the memecoin sentiment analysis models. Perhaps a touch of Pink Floyd's 'Money' is in order while I analyze. Anyone else find this correlation surprising? #DogeCoin #Coinbase
